'''May 2000 Cornwells Heights tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cormwells Heights, PA on 28 May 2000. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d863">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-memorial-day-bbq-5-28-00d863/ memorial-day-bbq-5-28-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 10 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-10-memorial-day-bbq-5-28-00d863/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Cormwells Heights, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
